description: This is a Java source file implementing a GLSurfaceView.Renderer for rendering sprite text in an Android OpenGL ES context. It manages texture initialization, drawing frames, rendering labels, and handling 3D transformations for display.

classes.name: SpriteTextRenderer
classes.description: Implements rendering logic for sprite text in OpenGL ES, manages textures, labels, and sprites, and handles surface creation and drawing frames.

classes.name: Triangle
classes.description: Represents a textured triangle used in graphics rendering, with buffers for vertices, texture coordinates, and indices, and functions to draw the triangle.

methods.name: SpriteTextRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with context, setting up label paint, and other components.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL state, loads textures, and prepares labels and sprites when the surface is created.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Per-frame rendering logic, including clearing buffers, setting transformations, drawing the triangle, and rendering labels and sprites.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix when surface dimensions change.

methods.name: drawMsPF
methods.description: Calculates and displays milliseconds per frame using NumericSprite.

methods.name: drawLabel
methods.description: Projects 3D coordinates to screen space and draws associated label at the projected position.
